subject: QBR prep: Forecast alignment and account deep-dive requests
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR prep: Forecast alignment and account deep-dive requests

Team —

We have our leadership QBR next week and I want the commercial packet to include a tight forecast rollup plus 2–3 account deep-dives that show health, risks, and playbook. Please do the following by EOD Friday: 

- Marissa: consolidate the committed vs. best-case numbers for each ARR cohort and flag anything that needs leadership attention.
- Vivek: attach the model-level forecast spreadsheet (one tab per segment) and a brief note on assumptions.
- Laura: pull latest usage metrics for the top 10 accounts (token spend, latency incidents, support tickets) and mark any with elevated risk.
- Marcus: draft one-sentence customer narratives for the three focus accounts (lead, ask, win conditions).

Attached a starter snapshot (QBR_pipeline_snapshot_2026-07-02.xlsx) — use the QBR template in Drive and add your tab. I want the final consolidated workbook and a 1-pager per selected account.

If any of you need more time, call me — but let's keep this tight.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_pipeline_snapshot_2026-07-02.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Forecast alignment and account deep-dive requests

Evelyn —

I'm on it. Quick notes from my side:

- I've started the rollup; committed ARR is $3.1M for Q3 across existing renewals and expansions. Best-case adds ~$900k from late-stage opportunities (see 'stage=proposal' tab).
- Two deals (DEAL-7442 with Zentry Health, DEAL-7561 with Acme) show close timing risk — both have procurement/contracting blockers.
- I'll flag DEAL-7442 for executive help (contract SLAs and entitlements discussion).

I'll upload the interim consolidated sheet by 12:30pm and put comments where I made judgment calls.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Forecast alignment and account deep-dive requests

Team —

Uploaded the forecast workbook to the QBR folder (Forecast_Model_Q3_2026.xlsx). Key assumptions called out on tab 'README':

- Renewal probability = historical cohort rate (70% for enterprise, 85% for mid-market).
- Expansion capture = 30% of pipeline-weighted expansion value in best-case.
- Contract slack: 2–4 week procurement delay baked into dates for healthcare customers.

Marissa: I left a column for 'lead ask' so leadership can see the support needed (e.g., credit, SLA exception).

Also attaching a small CSV export of Zentry usage per your ask, Laura (Zentry_usage_export_Q2.csv). Maria from Zentry pinged me this morning on a question about token billing — I included her in case we want the usage numbers verified.

-Vivek
Director, Revenue Finance

Attachments: Forecast_Model_Q3_2026.xlsx; Zentry_usage_export_Q2.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Forecast alignment and account deep-dive requests

Evelyn / team —

I've pulled the top-10 usage/export metrics and flagged three accounts with elevated ticket volume: Zentry Health, Acme (pilot), and one mid-market renewal (DEAL-7333). For Zentry: their token consumption spiked in late May; they filed two latency incidents (both on GPU-backed endpoints) and a small billing dispute.

I've created the 'Account_Deep_Dives_2026-07-02.pdf' with a one-pager for each candidate. Marcus — your customer narratives would slot into the summary page on the right.

Action items for the packet:
- Marissa: confirm the 'ask' for Zentry (recommended: extended credit + SLA review)
- Evelyn: do you want the exec ask to include a proposal to offer a short-term support credit?

Laura
Head of Customer Success

Attachments: Account_Deep_Dives_2026-07-02.pdf
From: Maria Lopez <maria@zentryhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Forecast alignment and account deep-dive requests

Hi all —

Thanks for the heads-up and the usage export, Vivek. Quick clarifications from Zentry:

- The spike in May was driven by a short internal experiment that has since ended — we do expect consumption to normalize in July.
- On the latency incidents: we opened two tickets; both resolved within our escalation window but we would appreciate a post-mortem to reassure our CTO.
- Procurement: our legal team has one comment on the SLA section (penalty language). We're willing to sign but need that item clarified.

Marissa — happy to hop on a short call this week to finalize the contract language. I've cc'd our procurement lead in a separate thread.

Best,
Maria Lopez
VP Product
Zentry Health

Attachments: none
